derivative_candidate.estimation: unpenalized pooled least squares, delete-one-subject jackknife covariance
derivative_candidate.simultaneous_band: two-sided Bonferroni t with G-1 degrees of freedom over the 20 frozen minute points
derivative_candidate.support_policy: simulation permits interpolation under a fixed correctly specified working basis, with actual minute support reported; real application requires complete intervals and at least 20 subjects
derivative_candidate.development_gate: coverage >=0.93 and successful_fraction>=0.99 in every noninformative cell
derivative_candidate.validation_gate: coverage>=0.93 and Wilson95_lower>=0.90 and successful_fraction>=0.99 in every noninformative cell
derivative_candidate.failure_policy: count all unsupported/rank/fit failures as noncoverage; no replacement replicates
derivative_candidate.simulation_target: analytic derivative of generating population mean at actual minute grid; Gaussian historical scenarios untruncated; informative selection cannot identify this target
derivative_candidate.real_target: derivative of fixed cubic B-spline projection of the conditional mean among complete-interval subjects, NOT an unrestricted instantaneous population derivative
derivative_candidate.real_application_policy: only if independent simulation gate passes; full complete interval only; projection target and selected population explicit; no imputation; historical estimator unchanged
derivative_candidate.basis_approximation_boundary: simulated analytic coverage does not prove coverage for arbitrary unmodeled functions or resolve E/T selection

reference_contract.matching_tolerance_role: engineering comparator specification, not acceptable timing-error threshold for HRV
